mcq_choices.rationale: Assumes any misalignment between force and displacement gives negative work, when a purely perpendicular force actually does zero work.
the dot product is negative for an opposing component
Ties the sign of work to the force's magnitude relative to weight rather than to the angle between force and displacement.

mcq_choices.choice_text: acts for less than one second
mcq_choices.rationale: Ties the sign of work to the duration the force acts rather than to the direction of the force relative to the displacement.

parts.prompt:
A force does negative work on an object when it

A. is perpendicular to displacement
B. has a component opposite displacement
C. is larger than weight
D. acts for less than one second

criteria.description: Select the single scientifically correct answer.
required_evidence: the dot product is negative for an opposing component

review_notes.expected_reasoning: the dot product is negative for an opposing component
known_boundary_cases: Check notation, sign, or limiting-case reasoning.
